sourceNote: SC-3 re-measurement under the current promoted versions, closing .planning/todos/pending/remeasure-baseline-fingerprint-post-trz.md (quick task 260904-4ik, Task 3). Read POST-HOC from the completed run reports/rolling-2026-09 (provenance.runTimestamp 2026-09-04T06:20:54.823Z); records opr@4.0.0+baseline, epa@2.0.0+baseline, vpr@7.0.0+rolling-2026-09. -- COMMAND IS RECONSTRUCTED, NOT A TRANSCRIPT: no planning artifact records the original invocation (grep for "reports/rolling-2026-09" across .planning/ and docs/ returns nothing, and the artifact's own provenance block carries only corpusIdentity/runTimestamp/seasonsCovered, no command). The reconstruction is `tsx --env-file=.env packages/harness/cli.ts --seasons 2022-2026 --algorithm opr,epa,vpr --include-offseason --out reports/rolling-2026-09`. Its one inferred element is --include-offseason, inferred from -- not witnessed by -- the fact that this run's per-season combined scoredCount matches the offseason-inclusive sc3-offseason-inclusive-2026-08.json exactly on every season (2022:14603, 2023:16290, 2024:16958, 2025:17815, 2026:18337). That same match is what makes the two fingerprints DIRECTLY COMPARABLE: they score the identical match population, which is the entire point of the re-measurement. -- CODE-CURRENCY CHECK: this run predates the five 260904-cs1 commits (4c96bb28..b94820b8, 2026-09-04T06:45:31Z..07:01:18Z) by ~25 minutes. Those commits made Sigma1's cold start positional (index === 0) instead of matching the module constant COLD_START_SEASON = 2022, now deleted. Three instruments were run before this file was committed. (1) Diff read across all five seasons: isColdStart moved from `season === coldStartSeason` to `coldStartSeason === undefined ? index === 0 : season === coldStartSeason`; over [2022..2026] both forms are true at exactly one boundary and it is the same one; fromSeason/toSeason untouched; SIGMA1_CODE_VERSION read 7.0.0 before, after, and at HEAD. (2) packages/harness/seasonBoundary.test.ts green (9 tests), including cs1's own byte-identical-to-the-stale-constant case over exactly --seasons 2022-2026. (3) packages/harness/digest.test.ts green (6 tests) on the CORPUS-BACKED path, not the skip path: vpr@7.0.0+rolling-2026-09's recorded prediction-stream digest reproduced bitwise under current code. SCOPE LIMIT ON INSTRUMENT 3, stated rather than glossed: its committed slice is sliceSeason 2022 only (3 events -- 2022alhu, 2022azfl, 2022azva -- and 265 matches), so it proves the COLD-START season and says nothing about the carried seasons 2023-2026. It is evidence paired with instrument 1's all-season diff reading, never sufficient alone. Verdict: no-op confirmed for this run's range.
